title: Mixed Event — Screaming?! Welcome to the Forest of Wolves! — Episode4 Me? A Wolf?

meta.Event: Screaming?! Welcome to the Forest of Wolves!
meta.Event Outline: The Miya Girls School Festival is fast approaching. Kohane was thinking about inviting the rest of Vivid BAD SQUAD and wondering what they could do throughout the day, but her class, 1-A, decided to do something An's not very fond of... A haunted house!

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy School Festival - Day 2

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wow...!
It's still the morning, but all these people are waiting outside the gate to visit our school!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Our School Festival's supposed to be pretty famous and tends to get a lot of visitors.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And it's great motivation for us...!
Let's get right to it this morning and do our best again today!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! And I need to do my best as a replacement wolf...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hmm... Which wolf costume am I supposed to wear?

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
Oh, Azusawa! Here's your costume!
Can you put this wolf's head on?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I-I'm playing the zombie wolf...?!
It looks so scary...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. It looks amazing, right?!
We had a girl from the art club make it for us.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, it's terrifying...
Honestly, it looks more like a monster from a horror film than a wolf...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: M-Maybe a little too terrifying...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was also a little worried at first about how scary it looks, but a lot of others kept saying that there are thrill seekers out there who like this kind of stuff.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, we decided that one of us can put this on whenever we see a guest who fits that description.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I mean, we want as many people to enjoy our haunted house, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, we had Shiho help us with making it look more realistic!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I do agree with the part about catering to the thrill seekers out there, but I doubt An will be able to handle something like this...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But we only use this whenever we feel it's necessary, so there should be nothing for me to worry about...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Now, you'll be wearing this gray hoodie and these gray sweatpants! We made sure to pick something that felt “wolflike”!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We'll give you the signal for when to move. All you have to do is slowly come out of the shadows!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
O-Okay!
Got it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Great!
Then, let's start getting ready!
Inside the Haunted House

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Look, guests!
Kohane, you're on standby!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...! O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Zip up the back and...
Hmm... It feels a little big...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But that should be fine. I'll be hiding for most of the time and don't have to move that suddenly when scaring the guests...)

rows.Speaker: Guest A
rows.Line: Aww, come on. This haunted house is totally meant for kids. What a bummer...

rows.Speaker: Guest B
rows.Line: Yeah... I thought it'd be scarier, but... Hm? Hey, isn't that the exit?

rows.Speaker: Guest A
rows.Line: Hey, you're right! Let's get out of here and check out the next class...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh... Th-These guests don't seem all that bothered by scary things...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
...
*Roar*

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: AAAAHHHHHH!!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(D-Did I do okay...?
They seemed pretty surprised when they saw me...)

rows.Speaker: Guest A's Voice
rows.Line:
Dude, that last one was so scary!
That thing looked more like a monster than a wolf!

rows.Speaker: Guest B's Voice
rows.Line: I know, right?! It was straight out of one of those jump scare movies! It got us pretty good, huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, that sounds like them in the corridor... The ones that just went through our haunted house...)

rows.Speaker: Guest A's Voice
rows.Line: Wanna go again? We can try being hunters this time!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank goodness. They seemed to have enjoyed it...
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Okay, it's been a while now...
I feel like my shift should be over soon.)

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line:
Kohane!
It's almost noon! Wanna swap soon?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, okay!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Wait, it's almost noon?
That means An and the others are going to be here in about thirty minutes. I need to hurry up and get changed.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I just need to unzip the back of the wolf's head...)
se_event_scream_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: H-Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's stuck...?

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, um... The zipper feels stuck...!
Sorry, can you take a look at it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Sure!
Oh, it's super stuck!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Gimme one second to undo this!
Here we... Gooo...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No...! It's not coming undone...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wh-What do I do...?!
An and the others are going to be here soon...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, I know!
Let's temporarily move out into the corridor! We should be able to see better there!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: R-Right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow, this thing's really stuck...
We might need to find a tool to undo this...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
W-Wait, but...
I promised to meet up with everyone soon...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I know...
Okay, sit tight for a second! I'm gonna try finding a tool that we might be able to use!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I should let the others know that I'll be a little late! Let's see... Where did I put my bag...? The class next door...?
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - School Gate

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're here!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Woohoo!
I can't wait to see what the festival at Kohane's school is like!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, give us a little warning before popping out like that. What if someone sees you?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<I'll be careful♪
Hehe. I'm so glad that I decided to see how practice was going for you guys! Now I get to see the School Festival!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I'm gonna rub it in Len's face later!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why do I get the feeling that you two are gonna have a fight after you tell him...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Anyway, we arrived a little earlier than expected. What should we do until it's time to meet up with Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wanna just start making our way towards her class? We might even get to go inside their haunted house early...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Gulp*
I was trying to not think about that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm still sort of surprised that you're not good with scary things, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Are you sure you're gonna be okay, An?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I appreciate your concern, Rin.
I'd be lying if I said that I wasn't scared, but I want to enjoy as much of the Miya Girls School Festival as I can today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, Kohane helped put this haunted house together, so I don't mind checking it out! Yeah, I'll be fine!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How'd you land on that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's not important!
So, let's start heading over towards Kohane's class!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This pamphlet says that the haunted house Azusawa's class made is supposed to be based on a fairytale...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “Little Red Riding Hood and the Young Goats' Slightly Scary Forest Adventure”...? That actually sounds kinda cute.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it's probably not gonna be all that scary.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What's wrong with that...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, I'm starting to get nervous... But...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, let's go!
Now, where's the entrance...
My bag... Where's my bag... Oh, here it is! At the reception desk!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? That sounded like... Kohane?
Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Wh-What is that thing...?!
A dog... N-No, a monster?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I believe it's... A wolf?
But it's rather repulsive...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Oh no!
I forgot that I'm still dressed as a zombie wolf...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An, wait!
It's me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nooooo!!!
se_event_scream_2022_002

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Eep!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Shiraishi, your phone...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: G-Get away from me...!!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Whoa, hey!
Where are you going?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-An!!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh no! I need to tell her somehow that it's me!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Wh-What happened?!
Why'd An throw her phone like that all of a sudden?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That voice... It's coming from An's phone... Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Eep!
Wait, huh? That voice...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Are you okay, Rin?
It's me! Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<I knew it was you!
Hang on. Why are you dressed as a super scary wolf?!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa? Is that you...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sorry, I can't get this wolf's head off...wait, not right now! I need to find An and explain the situation!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: D-Did you guys see where she went...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<An went that way!
I barely caught a glimpse of her before I fell!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I'll tell you where to go, Kohane! We can try finding her together!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Rin...
Okay! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Alright, let's go! First, go straight...!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kohane, I managed to borrow some tools! Huh? She's gone...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hanasato?
Oh, is this your class?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Shinonome! It's nice to see you again! Wait, no... Now's not the time for that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Did you happen to see where Kohane went?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, the wolf's head Azusawa was wearing gave Shiraishi a big scare. She ran off in that direction and Azusawa just went after her...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Seriously, how far did she run...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
In that direction?
Okay! Thank you guys so much!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess we should help find her too...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, let's go.
